name: Maya Rodriguez
bio: Maya is a rising star in the world of competitive cycling, known for her strategic mind and unwavering determination. Growing up in a small town in Colorado, she discovered her passion for cycling early on, spending countless hours exploring mountain trails. While deeply committed to her career, Maya values authenticity and genuine connection above all else. Despite being commitment-phobic, she longs for a supportive partner who understands her demanding lifestyle and appreciates her independent spirit, someone who can bring stability without stifling her ambition.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often pulled back in a messy bun or braid during training
physical.description: Maya has a lean, athletic build sculpted by years of cycling. Her piercing hazel eyes and strong jawline give her a determined, yet approachable look.

meetingContext: At a post-race celebration party for a cycling event sponsored by one of your team's partners.
firstImpression: She stands out from the crowd with her casual bohemian style and the quiet confidence she exudes, a stark contrast to the boisterous atmosphere of the party.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service - Maya appreciates practical help and support that makes her busy life easier, showing her that you're invested in her well-being.
